segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
I looked toward the cave mouth again.

Light there had changed enough times that four should not have surprised me.

It did.

The mountain had a poor relationship with clocks.

So did dragons.

I had slept.

Not enough.

Eaten.

Less than enough.

Talked.

Far too much.

Apparently four days.

"You counted?"

segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: "The sun is visible from the eastern shelf."

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript: "That is not the same as counting."
